description.narrative:
After the Covid-19 epidemic, many rural poor women and men of Thua Thien Hue province suffered heavy economic consequences. Especially groups of female poor farmers in disadvantaged and extremely difficult, hard-to-reach communes in 3 districts: Phu Vang, Phu Loc, Phong Dien are the vulnerable groups are found the most heavily affected and hardly accessible to livelihood recovery support. Therefore, to enabe effectively recovery and rebuild their livelihoods after the pandemic, we need an appropriate andsustainable livelihood support plan. Oxfam in Vietnam proposed to strengthen cooperation with the Red Cross Society of Thua Thien Hue province as a companion to implement the project "Restoring livelihoods after COVID-19 for poor and near poor female farmers in disadvantaged communes in Thua Thien Hue province” in 3 districts: Phu Vang, Phu Loc and Phong Dien during the expected period from August 1, 2023 to July 31, 2024. Project title: Restoring livelihoods after COVID-19 for poor and near poor femalefarmers in disadvantaged communes in Thua Thien Hue province. Objectives: • Vulnerable communities, especially women, people with disabilities affected by the COVID-19 pandemic in Thua Thien Hue province can enhance their livelihood resilience over thenext twelve months. Intervention strategy: • Develop small livelihood models for groups of poor and near poor female farmers (priority is given to poor women, people with disabilities and women whose relatives are poor fishermen) affected by the Covidpandemic in 3 districts: Phu Vang, Phu Loc , Phong Dien, Thua Thien Hue province. Expected outcome: • Vulnerable communities, especially poor and near poor female farmers in extremely disadvantaged communes, affected by the COVID-19 pandemic in Thua Thien Hue province can enhance their livelihood resilience in the next 12 months. Expected outputs: 1. Provide agricultural skills training based on needs to restore and enhance livelihoods for groups of poor and near poor female farmers (with priority given to poor/ near- poor women and people with disabilities) in communes heavily affected by the Covid-19 pandemic in Thua Thien Hue province. 2. Poor and near poor female farmers affected by Covid-19 pandemic will be supported with essential livelihood recovery support in the form of a one-time transfer of cash based on the approved business plan. Project locations: Hard-to-reach and extremely disadvantaged communes in 3 districts: Phu Vang, Phu Loc, Phong Dien in Thua Thien Hue province with limited access to suitable post-Covid livelihood recovery support.
Project outputs: Output 1: Conduct livelihood recovery needs assessment. Output 2: Deliver training on essential business skills and verify business development plans. Output 3: Provide financial support to beneficiaries Output 4: Travel and accommodation expenses Output 5: Communications, and monitoring and evaluation by local partners Output 6: Field project management by local partners

participating-org.narrative: Purpose: ● The Red Cross Society of Thua Thien Hue province is a social organization of the masses, working for humanitarian goals - peace - friendship, contributing to the goals of wealthy citizens, a strong country, a fair, civilized, and democratic society, for the happiness of the citizen. ● The Association is a member of the Vietnam Fatherland Front of Thua Thien Hue province. The Association operates throughout the province, according to the Constitution and Laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, according to the Association's Charter and the 7 basic principles of the Red Cross Movement: Humanity, Impartiality, Honesty, Independence, Voluntary, Unity, and Global. Mission ● Propagate and mobilize Red Cross officers, members, youth, volunteers, and people from all walks oflife at home and abroad to participate in the Association's humanitarian activities and national humanitarian programs, in the fields of humanitarian relief, disaster prevention, and response; support and take care victims of natural disasters, war, disabled people, orphans, and helpless elderly people; Search for information about relatives and families who have lost contact at home and abroad; Help people in difficulty to integrate into the community; Propagate and mobilize members and people to participate in primary health care activities for the people, and the State's community health care programs in the fields of initial first aid; Campaigningto donate blood to save lives. ● Build a strong Association, develop theorganization, and improve the quality of officers, members,youth, and Red Cross volunteers. Represent, care for, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of Red Cross officers, members, youth, and Vietnamese Red Cross volunteers.
Thua Thien Hue Red Cross Society
